inventory.responsibility: Watcher process lifecycle and iCloud file transport
inventory.b8d_destination: legacy-file adapter boundary; never CENTRAL execution authority
inventory.preserved_semantics: Explicit transport root, bounded stable-file detection, local launch lifecycle and archive-only file handling.

inventory.responsibility: Submission provenance, identifiers and compatibility normalization
inventory.preserved_semantics: Producer provenance and immutable prompt identity are input facts; filenames, CWD and source mtimes never become submission authority.

inventory.responsibility: Admission ordering, predecessor safety and recovery eligibility
inventory.b8d_destination: Downstream execution-admission protocol; submission admission only resolves registered CENTRAL project/repository topology.
inventory.preserved_semantics: Exactly one candidate is admitted, a blocking predecessor stops later work, and retry/reconciliation admission remains explicit and fail-closed.

inventory.responsibility: Execution ownership, lease/recovery coordination and merge hand-offs
inventory.b8d_destination: Future execution protocol and Project Agent boundary; explicitly not invoked by SubmissionService or Server.
inventory.preserved_semantics: A single runner owns provider invocation, recovery resumes the same run, and operator/finalization merge boundaries remain durable lifecycle checkpoints.

inventory.responsibility: Lifecycle projections, terminal evidence, reports and telemetry
inventory.b8d_destination: CENTRAL submission event/history projection plus retained downstream execution evidence.
inventory.preserved_semantics: Dashboard/status data is a projection of durable facts; terminal evidence is reconciled, never inferred from a successful transport acknowledgement.

inventory.responsibility: Historical retry, queue and file compatibility controls
inventory.b8d_destination: Legacy-file adapter or retained historical-reader surface; no new CENTRAL runtime dependency.
inventory.preserved_semantics: Queued retry children are inspectable, but legacy Markdown, archive moves and old watcher state cannot bypass canonical acceptance/admission decisions.
